title: "I Apologize For Not Understanding Your Policy": Exploring the Specification and Evaluation of User-Managed Access Control Policies by AI Virtual Assistants
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Virtual Assistants (VAs) regarding their ability to interpret and enforce logical access control policies for security and privacy. It does not evaluate religion, faith, or moral/ethical frameworks as part of its benchmarking process.
